source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Παπυλίνος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The page's whole account of him is one sentence**, «Ο Άγιος Παπυλίνος τελειώθηκε διά ξίφους», and one synaxarion couplet playing on his name — that Papylinus, finding his own breaking by the sword, broke the gates of delusion and its gods with it. **Nothing in the corpus reads like the name**: the sweep returned no `!!` row for this line at all, and the nearest thing in it is `papylas-the-deacon`, which is a different name. **No `dates` object, no `types` beyond `martyr`, no see, no city, no emperor, no hymn, no relics** — the page prints none of them and none is set down. The entry carries no asterisk and none of saint.gr's «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, so it is a thin entry and not a refused one.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
